title: Fourier regularity without small influences
statement: For every positive even integer $n$, there is a Boolean function $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$ whose nonempty-set Fourier coefficients all have absolute value at most $2^{-n/2}$. For every real $\\varepsilon<1/2$, this function does not have all its influences at most $\\varepsilon$.
